Source: So this is Coldharbour.
Target: 這裡就是冷港。

Source: Molag Bal's living room. ...Cosy. Reminds me of my ex's place — and I mean the décor, before your mind goes somewhere. Stop looking at me like that.
Target: 莫拉格·巴爾的客廳。……挺溫馨的。讓我想起我前男友家——我是說裝潢，別往歪了想。別這樣看我。

Source: You sound nervous.
Target: 妳聽起來很緊張。

Source: Nervous? Me? Ha. I'm never nervous. ...That burning manor I was trapped in once? This is practically a holiday compared to that. Stay close, alright. Not because I'm worried. I'm worried you'll get lost and then I'll have to come find you. That's annoying.
Target: 緊張？我？哈。我從不緊張。……那棟把我燒在裡面的鬼宅？跟那個比，這裡簡直是度假。跟緊一點，好嗎。不是因為我擔心。是擔心你迷路，然後我得去找你。很煩的。

Source: Thoughts on Pepe?
Target: 妳覺得佩佩怎麼樣？

Source: Our cursed tour guide. A Marukhati Inquisitor who's been damned for centuries — you can tell, he has that look. The one where you've been wrong about something for so long you've forgotten what right looked like. ...At least he knows where we're going. Probably.
Target: 我們的詛咒觀光嚮導。一個被詛咒幾百年的馬魯凱派審問官——看得出來，他有那種表情。就是你錯了太久，已經忘記對長什麼樣子的那種。……至少他知道路。大概。

Source: About that Inquisitor...
Target: 關於那個審問官……

Source: Burned people to prove his own holiness. The classic move — when you're that scared of being wrong, you make sure everyone else is wrong first, and permanently. ...At least when I'm awful I own it. Mostly.
Target: 燒死人來顯示自己的神聖。經典操作——當你那麼怕自己是錯的，就先把所有人變成永遠的錯。……至少我殘忍的時候，我還承認。大部分時候。

Source: The Mad King...
Target: 那個瘋王……

Source: Rich men and madmen. Nobody tells either of them their ideas are terrible. The only difference is madmen don't have enough gold to make everyone else go along with it. ...Usually.
Target: 有錢人跟瘋子。沒人敢告訴他們點子很爛。差別只是瘋子沒夠多的金子讓別人順著他。……通常。

Source: Marukh and the voices...
Target: 馬魯凱，還有那些聲音……

Source: Another one who started hearing divine instructions. Every time someone gets a direct line to the gods, the world gets a lot messier and the body count goes up. ...I hear voices too, but mine mostly just say 'you look great today, Sofia.' Much safer.
Target: 又一個開始聽見神諭的傢伙。每次有人跟神搭上直線，世界就會亂很多、屍體就會多很多。……我也聽見聲音，不過我的大概只說「索菲亞，妳今天很漂亮」。安全多了。

Source: Pelinal...
Target: 裴倫納爾……

Source: I've read about him. The books call him a hero. A saint. Alessia's divine champion. ...But look at him. He's not a hero. He's a machine that can't stop. He kills because stopping would mean thinking, and thinking would mean something he's not ready for.
Target: 我讀過他的故事。書上說他是英雄。聖徒。艾蕾西婭的神聖勇士。……但你看看他。他不是英雄。他是一台停不下來的殺戮機器。他殺人是因為停下來就得想，想了就意味著某件他還沒準備好面對的事。

Source: Do you want to be legendary?
Target: 妳想成為傳奇嗎？

Source: Me? Gods, no. Legends die badly and look terrible in the paintings afterward. I want to live, look amazing doing it, and be remembered as 'that incredibly attractive woman who was also somehow always right.' That's my version of immortality.
Target: 我？天神啊，不要。傳奇都死得很慘，而且畫像都很醜。我想要活著，活得漂漂亮亮，被記得是「那個超正又莫名其妙每次都對的女人」。那才是我要的不朽。

Source: He let her go.
Target: 他放她走了。

Source: He let her go. The slave. Umaril's woman, who would've been nothing to him but a weakness to cut off. And he let her go. ...Sometimes the legend and the man are the same thing after all. I hate when that happens.
Target: 他放她走了。那個奴隸。巫摩瑞爾的女人，對他來說本來不過是要斬斷的弱點。但他放她走了。……有時候傳奇跟人是同一件事。我最討厭這種時候了。

Source: He killed her.
Target: 他殺了她。

Source: Of course he did. She was in the way. ...I'm not going to pretend I'm surprised. The part of the story where the hero kills the pregnant woman — that's usually the part that gets left out of the songs. Wonder why.
Target: 當然殺了。她礙事。……我不打算假裝我很驚訝。英雄殺死孕婦的那段——通常就是歌裡被省略的部分。奇怪吧。

Source: He looked at you.
Target: 祂看了妳一眼。

Source: He looked through me. ...There's a difference. I've had all kinds of people look at me — the bad kind, the want-you-dead kind, the want-you-in-their-bed kind. This is the first time something looked at me and decided I don't exist. Not dangerous, not useful, not even amusing. Just... nothing.
Target: 祂看穿我了。……這兩個不一樣。我被各種人看過——壞的那種、想殺你的那種、想把你帶回房間的那種。這是第一次，有東西看著我，然後決定我不存在。不危險、不有用、連有趣都談不上。就是……沒有。

Source: Are you alright?
Target: 妳還好嗎？

Source: ...Not really. But here's the thing — if a Daedric Prince doesn't think I'm worth noticing, that means I'm not on the menu. And I like not being on the menu. So get in front of me, hero. He wants you. I'll be right here. Got your back. Obviously.
Target: ……不太好。但你知道嗎——一個魔神覺得我不值得注意，代表我不在祂的菜單上。我喜歡不在菜單上。所以走到我前面去，英雄。祂要的是你。我就在這裡。罩著你。顯然。

Source: Thoughts on this place?
Target: 妳覺得這地方怎麼樣？

Source: It gets to you. Not all at once — it's gradual, like a really boring inn that's slowly on fire. The grey. The nothing. The way time moves like it's given up. ...I'm not scared. I'm irritated. Those are different things. ...Mostly different things.
Target: 這地方會鑽進你心裡。不是一下子——是慢慢的，像一家很無聊的旅店慢慢地著火。那種灰。那種什麼都沒有。還有時間移動的方式，好像它已經放棄了。……我不是害怕。我是煩。這兩個不一樣。……大部分不一樣。

Source: We made it out.
Target: 我們出來了。

Source: Hm. We killed a Daedric Prince. Technically. Or we... convinced him to stop? I'm still not sure what we did. But we walked out. ...You know what the worst part is? I'm going to have to find a new thing to complain about. This was a pretty good thing to complain about.
Target: 嗯。我們打敗了一個魔神。技術上。或者說我們……說服他停下來？我還是不太確定我們做了什麼。但我們走出來了。……你知道最慘的是什麼嗎？我得找個新東西抱怨了。這個抱怨起來還挺夠格的。

Source: Was it worth it?
Target: 值得嗎？

Source: Don't ask me that. ...No, I mean it, don't. Because I'll say something honest and then we'll both feel weird about it. ...You made choices in there. Some of them were — look. We're out. That's the only part I'm keeping score on right now.
Target: 別問我這個。……不，我是認真的，別問。因為我會說實話，然後我們兩個都會覺得很奇怪。……你在裡面做了一些選擇。有些選擇是——你看。我們出來了。這是我現在唯一在算分的事。

Source: How do you feel about what we did?
Target: 我們做的那些事，妳怎麼想？

Source: I feel like we survived something we probably shouldn't have, made some calls I wouldn't want to explain at dinner, and somehow came out the other side with most of our limbs. ...Not bad. Honestly. For us? Not bad at all.
Target: 我覺得我們撐過了一件我們大概不應該撐過的事，做了幾個我不會想在晚餐桌上解釋的決定，然後不知怎的從另一頭走出來，肢體大致齊全。……不壞。說真的。就我們而言？一點都不壞。
